form.title: Edit product · {name}
form.intro: Policies already sold keep their own snapshot of the product - changes here only apply to trips from now on.

fields.isActiveDescription: When off, customers no longer see this option. Policies already sold are not affected.
fields.serviceFeeEnabledDescription: When on, every trip with vehicle damage insurance adds a collection fee = % of the premium. Renters see it merged into the insurance line with an ⓘ splitting the two amounts; it is refunded with the premium, and promo codes never reduce it.

help.maxPayoutNote: For example: “Up to the vehicle’s actual value”, “Per person, per incident”.
help.agencyCommissionPercent: Per the agency agreement with MIC - the default when creating a monthly remittance.
help.premiumTiersHint: Premium = vehicle value × the trip-length tier's rate (VAT included), per MIC's M1.11 schedule. Tiers increase in both days and rate; partial days round up to the next tier. Sold with eligible self-drive cars; the owner picks Required or Optional.
help.serviceFeePercent: Charged on the premium. A new rate applies to quotes and approvals from save - existing bookings and holds keep their locked amount.
help.partnerSection: Product code issued by MIC. The hotline is shown next to the certificate for renters and owners. The URL template starts with https:// and contains '{certCode}' - where the certificate number goes.
help.dailyAmount: Optional for the renter, charged per rental day. Leave blank or 0 to not sell it for that vehicle type. A new rate applies to quotes from save - existing bookings keep their locked amount.

validation.amountStep: The amount must be a multiple of 1,000 VND.
validation.urlTemplate: The template must start with https:// and contain '{certCode}'.
validation.tiers: Invalid tiers: days 1-30, rate above 0 with up to 4 decimals, both increasing.
validation.serviceFeePercent: Rate from 0 to {max}%, up to 2 decimals.
validation.serviceFeePercentRequired: The rate must be above 0 when the fee is on.
validation.agencyCommissionPercent: From 0 to {max}%, at most two decimals

voidDialog.hint: The reason is written to the system log and the partner case file.
voidDialog.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Trip cancelled after handover, partner confirmed cancellation
voidDialog.titleCancel: Cancel the policy and refund the customer
voidDialog.titleKeep: Void a policy that is in force
voidDialog.summaryRefundNow: The policy for booking {code} never took effect: cancel it and refund {amount} to the customer points wallet now.
voidDialog.summaryRefundLater: The policy for booking {code} never took effect: cancel it now; {amount} is refunded to the customer points wallet once the reservation payment is settled.
voidDialog.summaryViaHold: The policy for booking {code} never took effect: cancel it with no extra refund - the premium already went back to the customer through the reservation payment.
voidDialog.summaryNoRefund: The policy for booking {code} never took effect: cancel it with no points wallet refund - the premium was not collected through XePrime.
voidDialog.summaryKeepPayable: The policy for booking {code} is in force: voiding it does NOT refund the customer, and the {amount} premium stays on the insurer statement until the insurer confirms the cancellation.
voidDialog.referencePlaceholder: E.g. MIC cancellation document or reconciliation record number
voidDialog.referenceRequired: Enter the insurer cancellation code or reconciliation reference.
voidDialog.doneRefunded: Policy cancelled and {amount} refunded to the customer points wallet.
voidDialog.doneRefundLater: Policy cancelled - the premium is refunded once the reservation payment is settled.
voidDialog.doneKept: Policy voided - the premium stays on the insurer statement.
